fields.description: When off, every sale asks for confirmation (safest, slowest). When on, only large amounts, high discounts, and credit sales above their limits ask.
fields.label: Skip confirmation for normal sales

fields.description: Sales above this amount always ask for confirmation before completing.
fields.label: Large Sale Amount

fields.description: A manual discount above this percentage always asks for confirmation.
fields.label: Manual Discount Limit

fields.description: Leaving more than this amount unpaid (credit) on a sale always asks for confirmation.
fields.label: Credit Sale Limit

fields.description: Bikri isi godaam se katti hai. Ek se zyada godaam hone par ye zaroori hai.
fields.label: Bechne wala godaam

fields.description: Picked from the printers your browser/QZ Tray can see on this computer. Set from the billing screen's printer picker, not typed here.
fields.label: Selected Printer

fields.description: Print automatically the moment a sale completes, no preview or button press.
fields.label: Auto Print

fields.description: Send the cash-drawer-open command to the printer with every print (needs a drawer wired to the printer's kick-out port).
fields.label: Open Cash Drawer

fields.description: Your shop's UPI ID (e.g. santuhardware@okaxis). When set, printed bills show a scan-to-pay QR pre-filled with the bill amount. Leave blank to hide it.
fields.label: UPI ID

fields.description: Deprecated — superseded by the hashed PIN. Kept only for migration.
fields.label: Privacy Mode PIN

fields.description: Salted hash of the Privacy Mode PIN. The PIN itself is never stored.
fields.label: Privacy PIN (hashed)

fields.description: Public keys of devices allowed to unlock Privacy Mode with a fingerprint. Public keys only — no fingerprint data ever leaves the Mac.
fields.label: Registered Touch ID devices

fields.description: Epson print density (levels 1-7 = 85%-115%). Written to the printer's own memory via ESC/POS, not applied to the bill image.
fields.label: Print Density Per Printer
